privacy.sec_3_5_title: 3.5 Use of Meta Data and Specific Permissions
privacy.sec_3_5_text: For Facebook and Instagram integration functionality, Pixy requests specific permissions via Meta OAuth protocol. Below, we detail the exact use of each requested permission:
privacy.sec_3_5_list:
• pages_show_list

    Use: Allows listing Facebook Pages you administer so you can select which ones to connect to Pixy. We do not obtain data from pages you do not explicitly select.

  • pages_manage_metadata

    Use: Allows Pixy to subscribe to your page webhooks to receive real-time incoming message notifications. Essential for conversational CRM functionality.

  • pages_read_engagement

    Use: Allows reading comments and public posts on your connected pages so you can respond from Pixy's unified dashboard.

  • instagram_basic

    Use: Allows reading basic info (name, ID, profile pic) of Instagram professional accounts linked to your Facebook pages, to display them on your dashboard.

  • instagram_manage_messages

    Use: Allows receiving and responding to Instagram Direct messages (DMs) from Pixy interface. Without this permission, the unified inbox feature would not work for Instagram.

  • instagram_content_publish

    Use: Allows publishing content (photos, videos) to your Instagram account only when you schedule or execute a post from Pixy's Marketing module.
privacy.sec_3_5_storage_title: Storage and Security of Meta Data
privacy.sec_3_5_storage_text:
Pixy only stores the Access Token, Page ID, and Page Name to keep the connection active. This data:
  • Is stored encrypted in our secure database.
  • IS NOT shared with third parties, advertisers, or data networks.
  • Is used exclusively to execute actions you request within the platform (e.g., replying to a message).
privacy.sec_3_5_revocation_text:
You can revoke Pixy's access to your Meta data at any time in two ways:
  1. From Pixy settings, disconnecting your accounts.
  2. Directly from Facebook Business Integrations settings.

Upon revocation, our system will delete associated access tokens and immediately lose the ability to read or post to your pages.
privacy.sec_3_6_title: 3.6 AI Policy Compliance and WhatsApp Data
privacy.sec_3_6_text: In strict compliance with "WhatsApp AI Policy 2026" and Meta Tech Provider requirements, PIXY allows the following:
privacy.sec_3_6_list:
• No Training Declaration

    PIXY does not use, process, or share data derived from WhatsApp business solution (including message content, metadata, or user profiles) to train, improve, or feed Large Language Models (LLM), machine learning algorithms, or AI systems, our own or third parties.

  • Data Processor Role

    In the context of WhatsApp Business API data processing, PIXY acts exclusively as a Data Processor. We process information solely under the strict and documented instructions of the Client, who acts as Data Controller.

  • Conversion Attribution

    The user is informed that the ad click identifier (ctwa_clid) received via webhook is collected exclusively for technical attribution, effectiveness measurement, and client marketing campaign optimization. This datum is not used for unauthorized profiling.

art_automation.title: Appointment Automation: Recover the 30% of Leads Lost During Scheduling
art_automation.p1: "Can you do Tuesday at 3?"... "No, Wednesday at 11 is better"... "Oops, that slot just got booked". This email and chat dance is where sales go to die.
art_automation.p2_prefix: Eliminating friction in scheduling is one of the fastest ROI wins for any service company. Whether you run a dental clinic, a law firm, or a consultancy,
art_automation.p_cost: Each interaction required to schedule an hour increases customer drop-off by 15%. If it takes 4 messages to book a demo, you have lost nearly half of your prospects before ever speaking to them.
art_automation.quote: "Your customer wants a solution to their problem NOW. If they have to wait for someone to check the calendar tomorrow morning, they will go elsewhere."
art_automation.p_smart: Pixy's automated appointment engine is not just another form. It is a virtual agent that lives in your WhatsApp and Web portals:
art_automation.li1_text: Connects natively to Google Calendar and Outlook. If you book personal time, Pixy automatically blocks that slot for clients.
art_automation.li2_text: Pixy sends proactive WhatsApp reminders 24h and 1h before appointments, slashing no-shows by 60%.
art_automation.li3_text: If a customer cannot make it, they can reschedule with one tap without calling front desk reception.
art_automation.cta_desc: Stop playing scheduling tetris and let Pixy run your appointments on autopilot.
art_automation.p_beyond: The true power of Pixy is what happens after. As soon as an appointment is booked, a CRM profile is created, a preliminary agreement is generated, and your specialist is alerted—without lifting a finger.

art_whatsapp.title: The End of Being Left on 'Read': Why a WhatsApp CRM is Mandatory in 2026
art_whatsapp.p1: How many deals did you lose this month because a chat was buried under personal notifications? If your sales team still uses WhatsApp on personal phones, you are leaking revenue every minute.
art_whatsapp.p2_prefix: We live in an era of immediacy. In 2026, 85% of customers demand a response within 5 minutes. If they don't get it, they buy from competitors. The problem isn't your team's willingness; it's the
art_whatsapp.p_cemetery_1: Picture this: Your top salesperson, Luis, has 15 hot prospects. Today he called in sick. His chats are locked in his personal phone. Nobody knows what was quoted or when follow-ups were promised.
art_whatsapp.p_cemetery_2: That prospect won't wait for Luis to recover. That prospect will buy from whoever answers today.
art_whatsapp.quote: "Data trapped on personal phones is the black hole draining 30% of revenue from growing SMBs."
art_whatsapp.p_central_intro: This is where Pixy shines. By connecting your WhatsApp Business API line to our workspace, messaging turns into a high-performance command center:
art_whatsapp.li1_text: Your entire team collaborates on one inbox. If Luis is away, Ana takes over the conversation without missing context.
art_whatsapp.li2_text: Pixy displays customer purchase history, deal stage, and notes directly beside the active chat.
art_whatsapp.li3_text: Smart routing assigns incoming conversations instantly so no message goes unanswered.
art_whatsapp.cta_desc: Centralize your WhatsApp communications today and regain total control over your pipeline.
art_whatsapp.p_human_ai: A CRM isn't just about archiving; it's about velocity. With Pixy, configure autonomous bots that handle 11 PM price inquiries, share dynamic catalogs, and prepare warm deals for 8 AM closing.
art_whatsapp.p_roi: Our clients report a 40% bump in closing rates during month one by responding faster with complete context. Treat WhatsApp like the powerhouse sales engine it is.

art_omnichannel.title: The Hybrid Customer: Merging Physical and Digital Commerce Without Friction
art_omnichannel.p1: Modern customers don't think in terms of channels. They never think 'now I am an online shopper' vs 'now I am an in-store client'. To them, your brand is one continuous entity.
art_omnichannel.p2_prefix: Yet most businesses run physical retail and online commerce as if they were competing companies. If someone buys in-store, WhatsApp reps have no clue who they are. We call this
art_omnichannel.p_profile: Imagine this: Carlos spots an item on your Instagram, asks about stock on WhatsApp, and later walks into your flagship store to try it on. In old setups, the store clerk has zero visibility into Carlos's prior engagement.
art_omnichannel.quote: "True omnichannel isn't about being everywhere; it's about remembering the customer wherever they appear."
art_omnichannel.p_pixy_omni: Pixy Spaces synchronizes your digital touchpoints with physical POS terminals in real time:
art_omnichannel.li1_text: Every in-store transaction updates the unified customer profile immediately.
art_omnichannel.li2_text: If the last unit sells in-store, it is instantly marked unavailable across WhatsApp catalogs and web.
art_omnichannel.li3_text: 24 hours after an in-store buy, Pixy triggers satisfaction checks or personalized replenishment offers via WhatsApp.
art_omnichannel.cta_desc: Stop operating like fragmented silos. Deliver one cohesive brand experience with Pixy.
art_omnichannel.p_conclusion: Hybrid shoppers spend 30% more and boast higher lifetime retention. Deliver the seamless continuity they expect with Pixy's unified operating system.

art_commerce.title: Conversational Commerce: The Secret to Doubling Customer Retention
art_commerce.p1: Traditional e-commerce is lonely and disconnected. You land on a site, browse a product, add to cart, and checkout. If you have a question, you are stuck filling out a support ticket.
art_commerce.p2_prefix: Conversational Commerce shifts this paradigm: it turns shopping into an intuitive, guided conversation
art_commerce.p2_bold: directly inside the messaging apps your buyers use all day long.
art_commerce.h2_why: Why Does It Convert So High?
art_commerce.p_why: Human beings buy based on trust and conversational guidance. Buying via WhatsApp yields up to 3x higher conversion rates than static web checkouts.
art_commerce.quote: "Chat-based commerce restores human advisory and personalized trust to modern digital transactions."
art_commerce.p_how: With Pixy, you don't need a huge workforce to scale chat revenue:
art_commerce.li1_text: Deliver rich product cards with photos, live inventory, and one-tap checkout in WhatsApp.
art_commerce.li2_text: Customers complete secure checkout without leaving their conversation thread.
art_commerce.li3_text: If a customer pauses, Pixy sends gentle, personalized follow-ups that recover up to 28% of abandoned interest.
art_commerce.cta_desc: Discover how Space Tiendas scales conversational transactions from day one.
art_commerce.p_closing: The future of digital commerce is not a cold static catalog; it is an intelligent, high-touch conversation that nurtures loyalty.

art_chaos.title: Operational Chaos: 5 Red Flags Crippling Your Agency's Margins
art_chaos.p1: Does your team feel like they work 12-hour days but deliver 6 hours of actual output? The hidden enemy of scaling service firms isn't a lack of demand; it is operational drag.
art_chaos.p2_prefix: "Operational Friction" is the cumulative time lost switching between browser tabs, chasing credentials, and copying data between spreadsheets. In a 10-person team, those lost minutes add up to
art_chaos.p2_bold: weeks of lost billable capacity each year.
art_chaos.p_flags: If you recognize 2 or more of these symptoms, your operations need an urgent overhaul:
art_chaos.li1_text: Staff juggle WhatsApp, CRM, Slack, Google Drive, and spreadsheets just to answer one client inquiry.
art_chaos.li2_text: Confusing files named v4_final_final_approved.pdf floating unchecked across WhatsApp threads.
art_chaos.li3_text: Training new hires takes over two weeks because institutional knowledge is scattered across chats.
art_chaos.li4_text: Warm leads who said 'yes' go cold because contracts and invoices take days to send.
art_chaos.li5_text: Nothing ships and no deal closes unless the founder personally approves it.
art_chaos.quote: "True scalability is never about working harder; it is about eliminating friction so growth becomes the natural outcome of clean operations."
art_chaos.p_solution: Picture an operating system where every agency department has dedicated workflows while sharing one unified brain: Sales closes on WhatsApp, Billing triggers invoices automatically, and Production kicks off instantly.
art_chaos.cta_title: Is your workflow slowing your growth?
art_chaos.cta_desc: Audit your operational pipeline with our team and spot the hidden leaks costing you money.
art_chaos.p_central: Consolidating your tooling slashes multi-app subscription bloat and cuts cognitive load, letting your creatives focus on exceptional client delivery.

art_data.li1_text: Responding in under 5 minutes increases lead qualification odds by 7x.
art_data.li2_text: Knowing exactly what it costs to acquire a paying client from Instagram vs WhatsApp vs Google.
art_data.li3_text: The total gross profit generated by a customer relationship across their entire journey.
art_data.li4_text: The percentage of clients who cancel or fail to renew month-over-month.

art_data.p_dashboards: Pixy Spaces connects conversations, pipeline stages, and invoicing into live analytics dashboards so you always know your exact health metrics.
art_data.cta_desc: Empower your management team with real-time visibility across all business units.

art_data_extra.title: Data-Driven: Why You Need Dashboards That Actually Work
art_data_extra.author: 👤 Carlos M.
art_data_extra.p1: Are you still making strategic decisions based on spreadsheets your accountant emails on the 20th of the following month? In digital business, that data is already obsolete.
art_data_extra.p2: Being 'Data-Driven' doesn't mean hoarding charts. It means having the right insights at the exact moment action happens. If you don't know yesterday's numbers until next week, you're flying blind.
art_data_extra.p_vanity: Most CRMs flood you with decorative graphs. '10,000 Facebook likes' doesn't pay payroll. At Pixy, we focus on indicators that trigger immediate action:
art_data_extra.li_velocity_desc: How quickly do deals progress? If they stall at 'Proposal Sent', you have a closing bottleneck.
art_data_extra.li_cac_desc: Does WhatsApp deliver cheaper acquisitions than Instagram? Reallocate ad spend today, not next quarter.
art_data_extra.li_churn_desc: Pixy flags accounts displaying at-risk engagement patterns so your team can intervene proactively.
art_data_extra.quote: "Data without context is noise. Data paired with action is gold. Your dashboard should be your GPS, not just your rear-view mirror."
art_data_extra.p_realtime1: Pixy dashboards synchronize to the second. When a rep closes a contract in Bogotá, leadership in Mexico sees it immediately.
art_data_extra.p_realtime2: Customize role views: The CEO tracks company-wide ARR; sales directors track daily quota; support managers monitor resolution speeds.
art_data_extra.cta_desc: Take command of your company metrics with dashboards engineered for action, not decoration.

art_omni_extra.title: The "Hybrid Customer": Merging Physical and Digital Worlds
